title: Add remaining items necessary to allow mysql-server to be installed alongside mariadb-server

diff --git a/debian/mysql-server.postinst b/debian/mysql-server.postinst
index b416ef9..e6779ea 100755
--- a/debian/mysql-server.postinst
+++ b/debian/mysql-server.postinst
@@ -233,6 +233,31 @@ case "$1" in
       fix_old_config_options
     fi
 
+    # On a new install, if another server is already listening on the default
+    # port 3306, back off to port 3307 to allow MySQL to start.
+    mysql_port_cnf=$mysql_cfgdir/mysql.conf.d/99-port-backoff.cnf
+    if [ -z "$2" ] && [ ! -e "$mysql_port_cnf" ] &&
+       ss -ltn 2>/dev/null | grep -q ':3306 ' &&
+       ! service mysql status >/dev/null 2>&1
+    then
+      if ss -ltn 2>/dev/null | grep -q ':3307 '
+      then
+        echo "WARNING: Port 3306 and fallback port 3307 are both in use." 1>&2
+        echo "Set a free port in $mysql_cfgdir/mysql.conf.d/ for MySQL to start." 1>&2
+      else
+        mkdir -p "$mysql_cfgdir/mysql.conf.d"
+        {
+          echo "# Port 3306 was already in use when MySQL was installed, so"
+          echo "# MySQL uses port 3307 instead. Remove this file to use 3306."
+          echo "[mysqld]"
+          echo "port = 3307"
+          echo "[client]"
+          echo "port = 3307"
+        } > "$mysql_port_cnf"
+        echo "Port 3306 is in use, created $mysql_port_cnf for MySQL to use port 3307."
+      fi
+    fi
+
     # Sanity check to make sure the server can start
     test_mysqld_startup
 
diff --git a/debian/mysql-server.postrm b/debian/mysql-server.postrm
index de0e3b7..900d723 100755
--- a/debian/mysql-server.postrm
+++ b/debian/mysql-server.postrm
@@ -94,10 +94,23 @@ if [ "$mariadb_exists" = 1 ]; then
   echo "Found an instance of MariaDB $found_version, files will not be removed automatically." 1>&2
 fi
 
+if [ "$1" = "purge" ]; then
+  rm -f "$mysql_cfgdir/mysql.conf.d/99-port-backoff.cnf"
+fi
+
+# /var/log/mysql is shared with a co-installed MariaDB server, so leave it in
+# place if MariaDB's config directory still exists.
+mariadb_installed=0
+if [ -d /etc/mariadb ]; then
+  mariadb_installed=1
+fi
+
 # - When purging, ask if data files should also be removed   
 if [ "$1" = "purge" ] && [ "$mariadb_exists" = 0 ]; then
-  rm -f /var/log/mysql.{log,err}{,.0,.[1234567].gz}
-  rm -rf /var/log/mysql
+  if [ "$mariadb_installed" = 0 ]; then
+    rm -f /var/log/mysql.{log,err}{,.0,.[1234567].gz}
+    rm -rf /var/log/mysql
+  fi
 
   db_input high mysql-server/postrm_remove_databases || true
   db_go || true
